acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dialogues card appears after existing pipeline cards in the WP detail view
Card is hidden (not rendered) when getDialogues() returns an empty array
Dialogue entries are grouped by stage name
Each stage shows revision badges (r0, r1, ...) — latest revision is visually highlighted
Clicking a revision badge fetches and renders the dialogue Markdown inline using marked.parse()
api-client.js exports getDialogues(slug, wpId) making GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues?wp=:wpId
api-client.js exports getDialogueContent(slug, filename) making GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues/:filename
Rendered Markdown is displayed in a scrollable container consistent with the plan/synthesis rendering style
